recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-5912-specific core edit is needed; future changes to MedicationRequest.statusReason cardinality, wording, bindings, or event-history semantics should be handled under a later Jira that approves that specific change.
issue_request: FHIR-5912 was a Published FHIR-core Pharmacy issue resolved Persuasive for DSTU1. It asked to add a MedicationPrescription.reasonEnded CodeableConcept for statuses such as completed, entered-in-error, stopped, superseded, and possibly on-hold; the resolution also recorded a later Pharmacy desire to roll the change back and reconsider it with FHIR-8276 and FHIR-8378.
initial_application: Commit 3c8466459a1a9319f0d359b0418c84b87592fc16 explicitly added MedicationPrescription.reasonEnded to the historical spreadsheet source. Commit adf4e89f89fd36602f6b6e7520c1025949477424 later removed MedicationOrder.dateEnded/reasonEnded and added MedicationOrder.eventHistory under the related Pharmacy decision family. Current source contains no reasonEnded/dateEnded remnants.
additional_context: MedicationPrescription became MedicationRequest and MedicationRequest is active in the current build. Current MedicationRequest source defines statusReason as a CodeableConcept mapped to Request.statusReason, statusChanged as dateTime, eventHistory as Reference(Provenance), an example status-reason value set, and an example completed request with statusReason. FHIR-14020 later added the workflow statusReason alignment and is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Reintroducing reasonEnded would conflict with later Pharmacy rollback/event-history decisions, while current MedicationRequest.statusReason and eventHistory already carry the implementer-facing capability to explain current and relevant historical medication request status changes.

related_jiras.note: Pharmacy reconsidered reasons for status changes as part of adding eventHistory, matching the family named in the FHIR-5912 rollback note.
Asked for reasonToStop and reasonToHold and was resolved as part of the same eventHistory/status-reason path.
Approved removing dateEnded and reasonEnded while adding eventHistory, superseding the literal FHIR-5912 element.
Later workflow alignment added MedicationRequest.statusReason and is already represented on the combined branch.
A later retracted/no-change review of the MedicationRequestStatusReason value set leaves the current example binding undisturbed.
